interface.name: wp_scarlet_sgfx_v1
interface.description: Private backing for normal wl_buffer attach, commit and release. The fd is a Scarlet Linux descriptor containing a native SGFX image capability, exported with LINUX_DUP_NATIVE_HANDLE. It is not a Linux dma-buf. The compositor validates the image format and extent before accepting it. Only single-layer BGRA8 UNORM images are supported in version 1.
